provenance: x402 specification v2 section 5.5, Settlement and Refusal Identity Invariant, as proposed in x402-foundation/x402 pull request 3776 on branch spec/settlement-refusal-identity-invariant and not on main; checked against commit 8494922 on 26 October 2026
the gap these cover was named by ruiruii in erc-8004/erc-8004-contracts#99 on 18 October 2026: each of the four evidence layers depends on an attempt identity that none of them defines
the section names these vectors as the interim normative home until a permanent location in the x402 repository is agreed
encodes: A counterparty that recomputed, saw a different value, and signed anyway.
description: The clause makes recomputation a verification obligation with a refusal attached. Here the recomputed fingerprint differs from the ingress value and the signature was produced regardless, which turns the countersignature into a second opinion about nothing.
limits: This cannot show whether the counterparty recomputed honestly, only that it reported a mismatch and signed.
